entries.title: Move tasks on the task board
entries.body: Drag a task to another column on the task board, or press Space on it for its ⋯ menu. Queued lets it start by itself, Backlog makes it wait for your word, Working starts it now, and Drop task drops it. A move that could start work or drop it asks once, on the task itself, and nothing changes until you confirm. Dragging a finished task onto Done brings its completion card forward; only the card's own button merges.

picture.alt: A task dragged over the Queued column of the task board, the columns that take it tinted and the Drop task tray in the foot
